question: Which country is the smallest neighbouring country of India area wise?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhutan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhutan** is the **smallest neighbouring** country of India area wise.
 
• Bhutan has an area of **38,394 square kilometers.**
 
• Bhutan is located in the **eastern Himalayas** and is known for its stunning natural beauty.
 
• Bhutan is a **landlocked country** and shares borders with **India, China, and Nepal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nepal** is located in the Himalayas and shares a border with India to the **north**.

 
 
• It has an area of **147,181 **square kilometers.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka** is an island nation located in the **Indian Ocean**.
 
 
• It has an area of **65,610 **square kilometers and is separated from India by the** Palk Strait.**
 
 
 
• **Maldives** is an island nation located in the Indian Ocean and has an area of **300 square kilometers.**
 
 
• **​**It is located south of India and is** not** a contiguous neighbour.
